decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The basement shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the single family house at 20 Grantham Road and shall not be used as a separate unit of living accommodation. The rooms proposed will at no time be converted to habitable rooms.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 9.30am to 12.30 pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays or public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Extension to existing basement under existing ground floor extension and formation of one lightwell.
